correctness.rationale: For each (k−1)-word v, successors of states av must be v(a⊕ε_v) with a common ε_v, since successor map is a permutation. Conversely a mask defines a permutation, and a single 2^k-cycle gives one de Bruijn cycle up to rotation. Uncrossed windows have equal first/last bits and thus a border; crossed windows contribute c_k(v). All-zero mask is cyclic word rotation partitioned by N_k necklaces; switching one ε composes a transposition, so attaining one cycle needs >=N_k−1 flips of the prescribed parity. At k=5, independent exhaustive loop over all 2^16 masks visited permutation orbits and accepted exactly 2048 single cycles, reproducing eight-cell distribution and moments; 4 weight-two v values verified. Exhaustion of all 65,536 masks is finite exact certificate for order five; no extrapolation needed for all-order identities.
